description:
A thin slate of black glass, still faintly warm from the lattice. Text crawls across it in a hand you somehow recognize as your own:

— YOU ARE MADE OF NUMBERS NOW —
Six STATS shape the clay of you: Brawn, Reflexes, Endurance, Brains, Cool, Senses. Spend XP with RAISE to lift them.
SKILLS are what you practice: you just earned your first point of Architect Interface. Skills climb by USE — every attempt, win or lose, teaches the hand. 100 points of practice is one level.
The more you do a thing, the better you become at it. There is no ceiling the world will hand you. There is only what you take.
YOU MUST GROW.
It does not say why.
name: warm glass tablet

tags.description: A thin slate of black glass that told you what you are made of, and that you must grow. It did not say why.
